info.title: PodList HTTP API
info.description: Single-user API. Authentication and authorization are provided by reachability over the user's Tailscale tailnet (ADR 0004). There is no application login, bearer token, API key or cookie requirement. Keep the server private to the tailnet. Protocol version is also returned by GET /api/health. Paths include /api; use the server origin as the base URL. JSON endpoints return an empty 400 response for malformed input (HttpApiSchemaError); infrastructure failures may return 5xx. The media streams and WebSocket endpoint use raw HttpRouter handlers. Online read pages default to 100 rows, maximum 200. Continuations are opaque, bound to query, page size and State/Library cursors, and freeze relative dates. A 409 ReadChanged requires restarting from the first page; malformed or expired tokens return 400 InvalidContinuation. Server restart invalidates tokens. View limits apply across the entire result, including counts. Listening metadata includes removed Subscriptions and stored Episodes; combine it with State using Listening.stats on the viewing Device.

default.description: Other upstream status; body and Content-Type pass through unchanged.

get.description: Streams only the Episode audio URL in the Library. Follows upstream redirects; upstream status/body pass through, including errors beyond those listed. No transcoding. Range, If-Range, If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since are forwarded. Response Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, ETag, Last-Modified and Cache-Control pass through.

HTTP(S) Artwork named in the Library only (or already cached). Size defaults to 512 and rounds up to 64, 128, 256 or 512; values above 512 use 512. Returns square WebP, Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800.

Same-origin WebSocket. Origin is required and must equal the request origin (the HTTPS proxy preserves Host and sets X-Forwarded-Proto). State and Library query cursors are nonnegative safe integers, default 0. On connect, sends current cursors immediately, coalescing all changes since the client's last cursors. Sends changed cursors within 500ms and a heartbeat every 15s. Notifications invalidate reads; pull State and refetch reads, rather than replaying messages. reset=true means a cursor moved backwards: pull since=0. Always refresh on reconnect and tab return. If the socket cannot connect, poll GET /api/live/cursors and compare both cursors. No application authentication (ADR 0004).
